name: Divine Warrior
source: Ultimate Campaign pg. 64, Taldor, Echoes of Glory pg. 14, Advanced Player's Guide pg. 333
body:
Drawbacks
Divine Warrior
Source Ultimate Campaign pg. 64, Taldor, Echoes of Glory pg. 14, Advanced Player's Guide pg. 333
Category Religion
Requirement(s) Iomedae
From an early age, you were trained by a militaristic order of clerics. You are devoted to the teachings of Iomedae and to spreading those teachings by force. Whenever you cast a divine spell that affects any melee weapons, choose one of those weapons; it gains a +1 trait bonus on damage rolls for the duration of the spell.
